I am incredibly particular about my nails, so when I say this salon impressed me, I mean it genuinely.

The level of attention to detail was evident. Without me having to ask, they applied two coats of base and three coats of colour as a matter of course, exactly the way it should be done, and exactly the kind of thing that separates a truly skilled nail technician from an average one. The design I brought as a reference was replicated with impressive accuracy, and the range of colours available made the whole selection process an absolute joy.

Shaping is usually where I am very particular of. I have almond-shaped nails and getting that right on the first try is not something many salons can do, but they did, effortlessly and without a single correction needed. For my pedicure, they used a fine brush to bring the polish right to the very edge of each nail, a technique reminiscent of a Russian manicure, and the finish was immaculate.

The salon itself is clean, well-spaced, and comfortable, with two dedicated technicians, one for manicure, one for pedicure, so everything flows efficiently without feeling rushed.

For context on value: nail design, gel removal, chrome, pedicure gel and removal came to 750,000 VND in total. Exceptional quality at an exceptional price.

Yes, they did ask me to leave a review, but I want to be clear that I would have written this regardless, because results like these deserve to be shared. I will absolutely be back the next time I’m in Da Nang.

Lovely small local nail studio – cozy, clean, and professional.
This place is compact but very well organized. You immediately notice the huge selection of nail colors – neatly displayed on shelves, from soft pastels to deep reds, greens, blues, and trendy neutrals. They also have sample boards, so it’s easy to choose a shade or design without guessing.

Interior is super cute and calming: soft beige walls, decorative arch with the studio logo, comfy chairs, warm lighting, and small cozy details like cushions and decor pieces. You even get indoor slippers at the entrance, which is a nice touch and keeps everything clean.

Big respect for hygiene – they disinfected tools properly without me asking. You can also see professional equipment inside, towel warmer, clean storage, and certificates displayed, which gives confidence they know what they’re doing.

Staff is very friendly, quick, but still super precise. They listen carefully to what you want and don’t rush the job. Service feels personal, not like in big noisy salons.

Location is easy to find – street level with a clear sign outside, price list board, and phone number displayed. Prices are low compared to bigger salons, but quality is honestly great.

Perfect if you want a local, calm, non-touristy nail place with good skills and fair prices.
Definitely coming back – highly recommended

I decided to stop by this salon because my previous manicure was starting to fall apart and I needed a quick fix. I walked in without an appointment on a weekday and was greeted promptly and seated at a manicure table right away.
The technician worked quite fast and efficiently, finishing the job in just under an hour without any cuts. We selected a nail polish I liked and finished it off with a chrome powder. The total came out to 259,000 VND, which felt very reasonable.
I definitely got the impression that this place operates like an academy, as my technician had a mentor stepping in to give her pointers and advice. You should be prepared for the fact that some of the masters here are young or still learning. Also, if you have allergies, keep in mind that there might be a dog inside the salon.
As for the location, the salon is tucked away in a narrow alley, so you'll need to rely on your navigation and pay close attention to the turns. Inside, the space is bright, fresh, and quite comfortable. Overall, it was a good experience, and now we’ll see how long the manicure actually lasts!

reviewList.text:
We booked the 90-minute four-hands massage hoping for a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. We get massages regularly both in the US and while traveling, and have experienced four-hands treatments in many countries, so we have a solid basis for comparison.

While the massage may be acceptable by local standards, it did not feel like a true four-hands experience. The therapists were not synchronized at all. At one point, my left hand and fingers were being pulled while nothing was happening on the right side, which completely disrupted the flow a four-hands massage is meant to provide.

Communication was also very challenging. Without using a translation app, it was nearly impossible to communicate with the therapists. When I asked them to skip the bottoms of my feet, they didn’t understand. When I requested lighter pressure, they simply stopped working on that area altogether. During the session, my husband’s therapists chatted and giggled for much of the time, and my younger therapist occasionally joined in, while the older therapist remained mostly quiet. This was distracting and not relaxing—people go to spas to unwind, not to listen to staff conversations.

We had four therapists in total. The older therapist appeared to be guiding the other three, but one of the younger therapists pulled my left arm so forcefully that it caused pain, and I had to ask them to stop. The therapists also took bathroom breaks during the session. What made this uncomfortable was that they were using the bathroom inside the room, as we repeatedly heard toilet flushing, which felt unprofessional. One therapist slipped a couple of times while applying oil to my shoulder, indicating excessive oil use and poorly controlled movements. My left arm was still sore 48 hours later.

We didn't need pickup services and received the complimentary shampoo service while my husband had the foot scrub. I was led into a dimly lit room where three men were already having their hair washed, which was extremely uncomfortable. I later met them at check out and the guys also felt awkward when a stranger entered their space. I felt uneasy throughout the experience, unsure of what to expect. The stylist ended my session early, explaining that there were men in the room and took me back to the first floor to finish blow-drying my hair. For future guests, it would be helpful to clearly inform customers in advance that the shampoo area is a shared space so they can decide whether they are comfortable with that arrangement. My husband’s foot scrub, however, was fine. They also offer 15% discount off and I got a simply wax. Again, I used the translation app and it was ok.

Overall, the professionalism and coordination fell short of expectations. It wasn’t a terrible massage, but it was underwhelming and did not deliver the quality we anticipated. This service may be acceptable for guests new to four-hands massages, but for more experienced spa-goers, it may not meet expectations.

One big advantage is their free pickup and drop-off service within Da Nang city center, which saves money on a Grab. The owner contacted us on WhatsApp after booking and was extremely responsive and easy to coordinate with. Since we were already near the spa on our first visit, they even offered a free foot scrub or hair shampoo instead of transportation, which was a nice touch.

The staff were welcoming, and we had a couple’s room. The spa itself appeared very clean and modern, which made the experience even more comfortable. They also provide shorts for customers to wear during the massage, which both men and women use. The four-hands massage was very well done—the therapists were perfectly in sync and mirrored each other, creating a balanced and relaxing experience. Communication was simple but effective, and the full 90 minutes were honored. Afterward, they provided snacks and water.

Review: Lena Nails and Beauty — Da Nang, Vietnam

Lena Nails and Beauty is a standout choice for high-quality nail care in Da Nang. My girlfriend and I recently visited for a mani-pedi and a relaxing men's pedicure, and the experience was exceptional from start to finish.

The Lena Difference: Attention to Detail
What truly sets this salon apart is the meticulous care and attention provided by the staff. Both Nhu and Pi performed excellent work. They were patient, highly skilled, and crucially, took their time to ensure we were both completely happy with the results. There was no sense of being rushed, which contributes significantly to the overall relaxing atmosphere. The focus on customer satisfaction made the entire process feel personal and luxurious.

Selection and Value
The salon boasts a very large selection of colors, offering options ranging from long-lasting gel polishes to basic lacquer, ensuring there’s a perfect shade for every preference. Best of all, the service provided exceptional value. The quality of the work and the relaxing experience easily justified the good price.

Relaxing Experience
The entire experience was wonderfully relaxing. The combination of the attentive service and comfortable setting provided a perfect opportunity to unwind and recharge during our trip.

Verdict:

If you are in Da Nang and looking for top-tier nail and beauty services, look no further than Lena Nails and Beauty. For their professional staff, excellent color selection, fair pricing, and dedication to ensuring client happiness, this salon comes highly recommended!

Because of the humid, hot weather, her polish understandably took longer to dry. Unfortunately, she didn’t wait long enough before leaving, and her nails got smudged multiple times — first by accident, and later again when putting on flip-flops.

Tam kindly fixed the nails more than once, but the customer still became upset and blamed her. From what I saw, Tam handled the situation calmly and professionally the entire time. She even called her boss, and in the end, they refunded the customer, even though it really wasn’t the staff’s fault.

I just want to say that Tam did nothing wrong — she was patient, respectful, and did her job well under a stressful situation. Experiences like this say a lot about a business and its staff, and in this case, it only made me appreciate their professionalism even more.

reviewList.text:

I’ve been going here for about a year already. She’s upgraded her pedicure chairs to couches which I love! There are not many salons with couches- let alone a small shop like this.

I prefer the smaller shops over the larger well-known touristy ones. I find that the smaller shops have more skilled employees on hand than the fancy bigger shops.

One thing I love is that they’re extremely thorough with the heel-scrub/sanding. They use an electric sandpaper filer on your heels are dry spots and I always leave with the smoothest feet!
reviewList.author: Rosanna Tran

reviewList.text:
I did my acrylic nail extensions here 3 weeks ago and the retention is so good! I did a lot of packing and carrying activities this past week, and even accidentally knocked into a box, but the extensions and my nails remained so sturdy. There’s no lifting at all.

Binh was the artist who did my nails and she was quick, thorough and her painting is neat. Simple English communication is fine however it would be good to show the artist some reference pictures or use google translator as well. One of my fingers accidentally got nicked during the cuticle cleaning but Binh was very apologetic and quickly applied some medicine. There were quite a variety of nail colors and I really love my red-chocolate cat eye. I would definitely recommend this salon to others!

The price was very very reasonable.
The salon is neat, has a washroom, sweets and they have massage services too. My bf did a foot spa and shoulder massage. He mentioned the massage was very strong.

After the session, I chose a passion fruit juice from the menu, which was refreshing. You definitely can't get this level of service for 1,200 yen in Japan! Highly recommended if you're feeling tired from sightseeing in Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
❤️❤️❤️Feeling like a girly girl all the way.

reviewList.author: Sienna Tishler

reviewList.text: Sora K Nails was amazing!! I came with a nail design in mind and they were able to replicate it exactly! The application of the gel x extensions was very good and thorough, I believe these nails will last a long time. These nails are prettier than any nails i’ve gotten done in America! The staff was very kind! I would definitely recommend them to anyone visiting Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Rees Sitchon

reviewList.text: I came here for a gel manicure on my natural nails and Pha delivered. I showed her an inspiration picture and she mimicked it perfectly. I paid $750k VND, which I thought was extremely reasonable for the art I chose. If I had the same set some in the US, it would’ve cost well over $200 USD. I would definitely come back next time I’m in Da Nang. Make sure you allocate enough time for the service, my appointment took 2.5 hours. Make sure to bring cash if possible, credit card has a 3% surcharge

reviewList.text: There are so many spa salons in Da Nang, but unfortunately many of them lack proper hygiene and cleanliness. I’m so happy I found this salon — it’s one of the few places where I feel completely comfortable and safe coming with my daughter. The therapists are truly professional, they understand the body very well and always provide an amazing massage experience. I keep coming back here again and again, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality, cleanliness, and great service.
reviewList.author: Irina Pakudina

reviewList.text:
✨ Just had the most delightful experience at J&J Spa Nail in Da Nang! 💅💖
The moment I walked in, I was blown away by how clean and aesthetically beautiful the place is — soft pastel tones, fresh flowers, and such a cozy, relaxing vibe that instantly makes you feel pampered. It’s like stepping into a little oasis!
I got my eyelash extensions and a fresh set of nails done, and both turned out absolutely perfect. The attention to detail was next-level! Special shoutout to the lovely Ms. Thao — she was so gentle, patient, and talented. Her work is seriously amazing, and she made the whole session feel like chatting with a friend. ❤️
The staff (all the lovely ladies there) are just wonderful — warm, professional, and genuinely caring. I already can’t wait to come back for a massage and facial next time!
If you’re in Da Nang and need some self-care, definitely treat yourself at J&J Spa Nail. You’ll leave feeling like a princess! 👑
Highly recommend! 10/10 ✨

reviewList.text: Spa was really lovely and relaxed. I got a combo heel care and foot massage. Both were great and the staff were really friendly. Can’t remember the name of the girl that I had the pleasure of getting the service from but she was really sweet and done a great job 🥰

reviewList.text: 1hr shampoo & blowout is a must. Very clean and relaxing spa. Excellent service and they give u coffee. My husband had a massage and loved every minute. We will be back. Highly recommend.

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful massage yesterday. I’d been dealing with lower back pain for a couple of days, and after the session I felt so much better. Thanks to Tal, she is amazing, very polite, and did an excellent job. Extremely professional.

reviewList.text:
This time in Da Nang, I visited Ciao Nail Studio 2.
I had been to their first outlet before, and this time I saw on Instagram that they had just opened a new branch, so I decided to check it out. The photos showed a lot of attention to detail, especially in the interior design.

Today, I tried their foot treatment and manicure.
The environment is very comfortable, with plenty of natural sunlight. It feels relaxing and is also great for taking photos.

As for their skills, they are just as good as before. The staff were very attentive and careful with every step. After the treatment, my feet felt very smooth and refreshed.

I would definitely come back again next time I’m in Da Nang.
Highly recommended.

It’s also great for men. While I was there, I even saw two guys come in specifically for treatments.
reviewList.author: Bao Wei Chiok

reviewList.text:
I absolutely loved how my nails turned out! The work was beautiful, neat, and exactly what I wanted. The staff were very friendly, and the service was quick and efficient, which made the whole experience enjoyable.

The only thing I was expecting, especially for the price of 200,000 VND, was a little more foot care, such as soaking my feet or a light exfoliating treatment. I think that would have made the service feel more complete.

Overall, I’m very happy with the results and would definitely come back because of the quality of the work and the kindness of the staff. 💅✨

reviewList.text: Me and my friends got our nails done and we are obsessed! I got exactly what I asked for and the staff were extremely polite! They even offered free drinks and took their time making sure everything was perfect. I couldn’t recommend them enough!

reviewList.author: Steve Cheng

reviewList.text:
Prenatal massage was so relaxing and comfortable 🤍

I especially appreciated how gentle they were with the massage pressure for pregnancy.
Highly recommend for moms-to-be visiting Da Nang!
reviewList.author: DH K

reviewList.text: The ladies here took excellent care of us; they were friendly, attentive and provided lovely service. Booked a spa date for myself, my mother, aunt and sister. We opted for 90-minute aroma massages, gel pedicures with scrubs and manicures. I’m going to highly recommend the scrub, our feet are now baby soft. The gel color selection could be better and I wish I didn’t hear all the construction noise during my massage but still had a great experience.
reviewList.author: L

reviewList.text:
This is by far the best massage shop I’ve ever been to! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm smile and a relaxing atmosphere. The place is spotless, beautifully decorated, and has a calming scent that instantly puts you at ease.

The therapist was incredibly skilled and attentive, making sure to focus on my problem areas while still giving a full, balanced massage. The pressure was perfect firm enough to relieve tension, but gentle enough to make me completely relax. I could feel the stress melting away with every minute!!!! I wanna come  again……😭😭😭 thank you!
reviewList.author: Chlo Park

reviewList.text: We booked a massage for my family of four. The massage was great. This was my five-year-old‘s first time getting a massage and he literally fell asleep. We thoroughly enjoyed this experience and hope to come back again in the future.
reviewList.author: Faris Flournoy

reviewList.text:
I am truly disappointed with my experience at this shop. My appointment was booked for 8.00 PM, yet the service only began around 20 minutes later with no proper explanation for the delay.

During the facial cleansing, the therapist stopped halfway and walked away, leaving me lying there for about 10 minutes. I was later told it was because the new shop did not have enough manpower. This made the whole experience feel very unprofessional and poorly managed.

The nail shaping was also badly done and the uneven edges and rough finishing. For a service that is supposed to be relaxing and worth the price, it turned out to be the opposite.

Overall, the service quality was far below expectations. Considering the amount paid, it definitely did not feel worth the money. I would not recommend this place to tourists or anyone expecting proper, attentive service.
reviewList.author: Ann Ng

reviewList.text: I only give three stars because upon walking in and seeing that the place was completely empty and void of any other patrons looking for a service. My wife and I decided to both get manicures and pedicures at as it had been a while and we've been traveling and wanted to make sure we took care of ourselves. My wife immediately got taken care of with a well-done gel, manicure and pedicure and foot scrub. I however was only given a manicure and even after repeated requests for a pedicure I was completely ignored and rushed out the door instead of being given a pedicure. They also refused to accept our credit cards even though they have Visa, logos and everything all over the payment counter. I was a little off put at how unwilling they were to communicate and how little we were able to understand them as opposed to the other places that there are multitude of in the area. I would say if you're looking for manicures and pedicures go somewhere else, there's way better values for your dollar out here
reviewList.author: Justin Barnes

reviewList.text: Booked 8pm then assigned to upstairs for service, everything get ready then no people come to serve us and wait almost 20 minutes. Cut and sharp not evenly. Worst service ever!

reviewList.text:
We had a truly wonderful experience at this spa. The environment was clean, calm, and beautifully maintained — perfect for relaxing and unwinding. The team was also very responsive and efficient — from booking to after-service follow-up, everything was handled promptly and smoothly.

What really stood out was the level of care and service. As my elderly family members went on their own, the owner kindly arranged a Grab to pick them up and ensured they returned to the hotel safely. This thoughtful gesture meant a lot to us and truly reflects the spa's commitment to customer care.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a good and heartfelt spa experience!

I got foot care and a heel scrub. The price was amazing - 20k VND after using massage services plus 20% off of the 150k-ish VND for the heel scrub (I can’t remember the exact price but both services for my husband and I came out to less than 300k total).

The service itself was great! My feet are very soft. But the chairs were old and the leather had cracks. I was concerned about the hygiene when I saw the nail technician use the same nail drill that was used on my husband’s feet on another woman for her manicure, with no cleaning or sanitization in between.
reviewList.author: Soyoung Jang

reviewList.text: Soothing! The waiting lobby was nice and the massage was a relaxing experience. Appreciate the tea and snacks provided afterwards!
reviewList.author: Mark Nguyen

reviewList.text: Lovely nail salon. I looked it up online and looked clean and safe and it was just that! The staff welcome you by opening the for you and offer you delicious tea. Then they take you to the back room for nails. There are many colours to choose from. And they have lots of different designs you also choose from. The nail tech works on making sure your nails are perfect, by working on the cuticles and shaping and making sure it’s the colour you want in the end. I enjoyed the experience and happy with my results!
reviewList.author: Maile Davis

reviewList.text:
My experience with them was quite disappointing. I got gel nail polish done just yesterday, and the yellow paint has already started peeling off today. I repeatedly mentioned that the yellow polish quality seemed poor, but they kept insisting that the issue was me “not keeping my hand still,” which felt quite dismissive—especially because all my other nails with other colour (orange) turned out perfectly fine.

The worst part is that when I raised my concerns, they were talking about me poorly to each other in Vietnamese . It made me feel very unwelcome.

Despite pointing the issue about yellow paint multiple times, they only agreed to redo my right thumb, which actually came out fine once they changed the shade. They still charged the full price, even though the service didn’t meet what they promised. Overall, it was a waste of both time and money. All the nails painted in yellow are now completely chipped.

reviewList.author: Dee D

reviewList.text:
This is a lovely nail salon with great service but could use more knowledge and expertise. For example, I came in with old regular nail polish that only needed to be removed with acetone, but they instead treated it as gel and used an electric nail file. I also requested nail extensions on two nails and they mentioned they would use an acrylic extension method but instead used press ons and nail glue (not gel x) which is a method that will not last as long.

However, the girls provide a lovely service and are very detailed and meticulous (maybe too much!). They mentioned that my appointment for a single colour gel manicure would take 30 minutes, but it instead took 2 hours. They put a lot of effort into cuticle care, filling and applying the nail polish. They also provided two layers of reinforcement gel for no extra price as well as cuticle oil and a short hand lotion massage. The whole service cost me 190,000 vnd which is a very good price.

I would recommend this nail salons for the price and quality of service but if you are looking for a short and efficient nail service, this may not be the place for you.

reviewList.text:
🚨GET PRICING BEFOREHAND

Services are pretty good. So good that I decided to add on extra services. Both ladies did very very well.

I was willing to go to ATM to get more cash since the person with the card machine was not at the location, but I was told card was okay it was just a short moment. The price and I first got was not the pricing I got the second go round, particularly the percentages. Usually for card a lot of places charge 3% to 5% for most if  not all places I went to since being in Vietnam. This one charge 20% when I was told it was going to be 20.000 plus by the first guy (which is roughly around 4% with my base total). I’ve been to nicer salons in Da Nang and was never charged that much. So have cash or get your price all the way beforehand
reviewList.author: Mariann Collins

reviewList.text:
Bumped into this place while i was looking for a money exchange shop and couldn't find any since my phone didn't have internet connection. I randomly asked one of the staff to point me to the nearest money exchange and even helped me get quick access to internet for proper google maps directions.

The following day, I went back to the store to avail one of their services as a way to thank them for the kindness they've shown the previous day. I've been walking on an average of 15k steps/day while exploring Da Nang and just realized maybe it's finally time to get a foot scrub and foot massage for the first time in my life (since i've also noticed that it is in almost every street near my hotel).

Surprisingly the foot scrub did not hurt at all. It kinda looked gross to see all the dry skins be flying all over the towel which made me feel bad for the staff doing it since it's my first time experiencing this haha. I even had to type in Google Translate how sorry i was. Out of embarrassment, i just gave a slightly higher tip to the staff. Even now that i left Da Nang my foot is still smooth and still feels unusual for a first timer.

I loved the friendliness of the staffs that i had to go back the following day and avail of their foot massage before i leave the country. This time the staff who accommodated me really took her time with the foot massage which i genuinely liked. The pressure was not that hard as much as i wanted it to be but it's decent to feel relaxed especially with the hot stone. (I also just didn't know how to properly communicate that i wanted stronger pressure haha).

Overall, it was nothing fancy or high-end, but it was definitely a great and memorable experience for me as a first timer and will definitely be back if I get a chance to visit Da Nang again in the future.

+ this spa also led me to discover one of my go to chicken shredded banh mi stores in Da Nang. It's just beside each other.

reviewList.text:
I went to ZozoNails during my vacation here today because of all the great reviews on Google but I am unlucky enough to have a terrible experience there.

I chose to do a Gel Manicure and a normal Pedicure, they are both very reasonably priced.

Pedicure was where my nightmare begins , it was honestly the most painful experience I have had at a nail salon, at first Staff A (a gentleman) was doing my cuticle cutting and he managed to cut through my cuticle and left it bleeding. (Both my big toe and my middle toe). I was shocked and he only used water and cotton to clean it until I expressed my worries, and asked 'Is it okay?' No apologies received, but thank god he went to get some disinfectant to put it on my cuticle - which you can imagine, it was PAINFUL. (You can see attached photo)

After that, it was already very uncomfortable obviously but the worst was when the inexperienced Staff B (another gentleman) was putting the nail polish on, and made mistakes for like 3-4 times.... my cuticle were stinging so badly when he used the nail polish remover to clear the uneven polish before he can re-do it again. It was a torture...

Okay, onto the Manicure, Staff B was responsible for filing the previous gel away and that was very rough, a few times I actually withdrawn my hand reactively because I felt like he was gonna file my cuticle off. After he went on to do my pedicure as I mentioned above, Staff C (a lady) was responsible to do my manicure instead, I requested not to get my cuticle cut so I thought it will be fine. AND I WAS WRONG, she managed to clip the skin next to my nail until the flesh of the underside of the nail is exposed (as you can see on the attached photo), it wasn't bleeding but it hurt a lot and it's all red and exposed....

The manager apologised after I expressed how frustrated I was and waived me the cost of the pedicure. In the end It was a very cheap deal but it was an awful and painful experience that I wish I have never come across.

Sadly this is my honest review, I cannot even say I have been allocated to 1 inexperienced staff, because I have had 3 and they were not professional IMHO.

Uneven filed nails, bubbles underneath the gel nails (which are also my case) - Fine, it's a very affordable place, I don't expect 5 stars quality, but bleeding in a nail salon? No thank you, that is just a basic expectation. Not mentioning now I might have the risk of getting an infection in the coming few days.....

I hope this review is helpful and I would like you to think twice before you go.
